scope: Read-only offline Helm render review; no candidate image digest was accepted or deployed.

red_green.red: Three new tests failed before implementation: no override binding or digest report, unsafe/extra Helm values were not rejected, and Helm ignoring the requested image was accepted.
red_green.green: Eight focused reviewer tests and 77 onboarding/render/quality/pipeline tests passed; Ruff check, format, and git diff checks passed.

contract.source: The local checkout must be clean at the exact intake-pinned Git revision.
contract.values: Only runtime.workload.helm_values.app.image may be supplied; it must be an immutable sha256 image reference safe for one --set-string argument.
contract.binding: The canonical Helm override SHA-256 and rendered manifest SHA-256 are recorded, and the exact image must appear in a rendered image field.
contract.output: Stable findings, counts, and hashes only; no raw manifest, image reference, secret, or provider output.

limitations: This is a developer preflight, not a trusted isolated renderer or signed receipt.
No pushed image digest exists from the new source; the Quay candidate publisher was only tested with publication disabled.
Signature, SBOM, source provenance, registry pull, model endpoint, identity, route, capacity, and reclaim are not certified.
